# Application Indicators - Takes menus from apps and puts them in the panel
Application Indicators is a library adherent to the Atayana Indicators spec that provides a library to have app-specific menus that would be part of an app, detaches the app-specific menus and makes them become part of the panel

## Features
 - Interfaces with the Atayana Indicators library
 - Aids user experience while using the Atayana Indicators stack
 - provides macos-like top bar experience
